title: Replace Preview
summary: Previews every find-and-replace match in context before applying, so "cat" → "dog" doesn't turn "category" into "dogegory".
description: Find-and-replace that previews every match in context with a count, names matches inside longer words with a one-tap whole-word fix, preserves case, lets you skip single matches, and undoes the replace.
catches: Matches that sit inside longer words, with a whole-word fix
Individual matches you want to skip
Case of each match, preserved in the replacement (CAT → DOG)
limits: Word boundaries follow simple letter rules and may differ for some scripts
Undo covers the last replace only
a11y: Find and replace inputs have labels
Match-case, whole-word and preserve-case are aria-pressed toggles in a labelled group
Match list has an aria-label with the count; each include/skip control has its own label
Warnings and the result render in polite live regions
